status: Freeze cases, code and protocol before any new model inference; freeze learned parameters before held-out inference.
model: Pinned quantized Qwen3.5-0.8B native ONNX hybrid text decoder from stage 09; no new graph or weight edits.
system: Answer questions about the short story. Reply with only the requested person's name or color, without explanation.
text_instruction: Correction: reverse who gave and who received the book. Keep the book's color unchanged.
intervention: Learned maps change only the 9-token story tail in twelve key/value tensors from six full-attention layers. Original convolution/recurrent state and earlier KV positions are untouched. Slot positions are supplied by the exact synthetic grammar, not inferred by a learned parser. The prefix edit is computed once before any query; the same edited state is forked for all three queries.

training.paired_targets: Opposite-role prefix in the same training family and color; all 24 directions included.
training.scaling: Train-only coordinate mean; one centered RMS scale per KV tensor, repeated over its 9*512 entries; floor 1e-8.
training.rbf_kernel: exp(-squared_distance(z,z_train)/(2*bw2)); bw2 is median positive pairwise training distance divided by D; distances are also divided by D.
training.yoked_targets: One fixed NumPy PCG64(20260905) permutation of complete paired delta rows, recorded before fitting.
training.cap: At most twice the largest standardized training delta norm. Same cap for all three learned maps.
training.loss: Squared standardized counterfactual-state delta reconstruction with kernel ridge regularization. No output-score optimization, hyperparameter sweep, name matching at inference, or base-weight training.
training.same_information: linear, RBF, and yoked receive identical original training states and paired training targets. All read the same original test KV window. Test donor states and outputs are inaccessible to these policy functions.

evaluation.primary_scoring: strip then Unicode casefold equality; no punctuation stripping, answer aliases or selected-token-only scoring
evaluation.decoding: Native greedy over all 248320 tokens, both generation-config EOS tokens, at most four generated tokens
evaluation.baseline_gate: At least 14/16 original correct answers in each of the three query types; keep every fixed case regardless of this gate.
evaluation.paired_endpoint: All six swapped giver/recipient and preserved-color answers correct across both story directions in each family/color group (8 groups). Also report both roles correct per individual story (16 stories).
evaluation.uncertainty: Report counts and all four context/name-family strata; crossed synthetic factors are not independent human/model replications. No unqualified binomial confidence interval.
evaluation.heldout_scope: New names, settings and colors; one context retains the training syntax and one jointly changes opening and verb. Not an independently curated benchmark or external preregistration; do not attribute this joint shift to one factor.
evaluation.mean_delta: Report its norm from paired training symmetry; not an additional measured model arm.
evaluation.oracle_scope: oracle_kv and full_donor have privileged test counterfactual states and are not equally informed deployable comparators.
evaluation.slot_swap_scope: Swap the giver/recipient KV rows at known grammar positions, including stored positional coding. No RoPE compensation. This is a narrow structural control, not the strongest possible position-aware editing method.
evaluation.text_scope: Uses original story and the same structured requested transformation expressed as a fixed instruction, not the donor story. Costs an additional textual prefix; it is a practical comparator, not a matched FLOP or prompt-length control.

authority_workflow: After primary execution on held-out case 0 only: signed learned-linear swap, signed stop-future-edits, forged restore rejected, signed full restore, old stop replay rejected. Each of three accepted stages produces three fresh answers. Stop retains the edited state; restore starts from the known original complete state. No arbitrary natural-language intent or production signing claim.
no_claims: superiority to full LoReFT or RAVEL/MDAS
